name: incantation
description: A voice pair-programming partner for Claude Code, through Voicebox, on any platform Voicebox runs on. /incantation turns a session into a spoken conversation: it listens at all times, never to its own voice, says each request back before it acts, and speaks only when something needs the person. It ships a guard that checks the setup is local only, a setup script you run in your own terminal, and its own listener. It needs Voicebox and ffmpeg on the same machine.
